_note: Four Access Zones proposed by HWS on 13 November 2026, added on the same
day. The client's note gave a 'who it gives a clearer route to' paragraph
for each; the focus line below is that paragraph in the register the
other eight use — a short phrase, not a sentence.
Slugs are permanent: they are the URL of the zone page and the key every
translation hangs off. Renaming one later orphans its translations, which
is what npm run check:vocab reports.
